results.name: NT-08: changing notes asks; Cancel preserves all edits, Save commits before navigation and no delayed draft resurrects
NT-08: New and window Close cannot silently destroy dirty Notes; cancel both native UI actions
NT-09: a real sessionStorage draft survives reload, restores exact text with its old revision, and Save clears it
NT-10: another real HTTP writer wins; stale UI save is refused, editor text remains, and confirmed Reload obtains the winner
NT-09 patch attack: temporarily blank titles are recoverable editing states, and Discard draft does not write the note
NT-11: local full-text filtering composes with stored-tag filtering, preserves selection, and has a real empty state
NT-12: preview renders a safe Markdown subset without executing raw HTML, loading remote images, or enabling javascript links
NT-13: native file input imports fatal UTF-8 Markdown into a persisted indexed note; invalid UTF-8 cannot add a note
NT-14: real wiki navigation and reverse backlinks open the correct notes; absent and ambiguous destinations cannot choose an arbitrary record
NT-14 saved-identity attack: an unsaved rename keeps the real backlink, and borrowing another saved title cannot impersonate its destination
NT-15: outline is clickable, fence-aware and shares exact preview line IDs, including indented headings far below the fold
NT-16: native textarea selection creates an exact independent note, leaves its source unchanged, and an empty selection cannot extract
NT-17: interactive checklist checks and unchecks the right source marker; saving/reopening preserves other lines exactly
NT-18: an actual browser download is self-contained UTF-8 Markdown, includes unsaved text and cannot write a VFS file
SR-13: the actual source control changes the native request and excludes other kinds, including an empty wrong source
SR-14: title and reference orders rearrange only the returned result set deterministically
SR-15: literal matching keeps internal whitespace and SQL wildcard characters literal, without ranked/fuzzy matches
SR-16: file suffix control is case-insensitive and literal, and a non-file source disables/clears it
SR-17: native confirmation cancels without a rebuild, then a real confirmed rebuild preserves source bytes
SR-18: path diagnosis shows an indexed real file, a nonexistent file, and invalid path refusal without hiding a previous diagnosis
SR-19: Enter records complete history, Cancel keeps it, Clear deletes it and reload cannot resurrect it
SR-19 patch attack: clearing history while a genuine PostgreSQL table lock holds a search cannot be undone by the late response
SV-02: saved profiles replay every control instead of inheriting current phrase/field/source/filter state
SV-03: native JSON download → delete → file import restores complete profiles; cancelled and invalid imports leave the list untouched
Regex repair: native Worker times out hostile backtracking while the UI continues painting, then a corrected filter recovers
Regex patch attack: three genuine metadata pages accumulate 65 matches; all pass the worker's 50-text messages under one total budget
No uncaught browser errors across Notes/Find native interaction cases
